data_partition.calibration: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 1
data_partition.selection: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 2
data_partition.confirmation: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 0

mechanism.signal: mean absolute disagreement of the existing sequence and feature coordinate branches
mechanism.action: attach one of FARTrack's four already emitted native attention-pruning masks to the just-written template; template identity, write timing, chronological sampler, current box and one forward remain unchanged
mechanism.host_sync: no new softmax, item(), or tolist(); trigger and mask selection remain CUDA tensors

calibration_selection_rule: among adaptive candidates only, choose maximum AO subject to aggregate FPS no lower than 95% of disabled baseline; ties prefer lower pruning

selection_gate.run_confirmation_only_if: the one frozen calibration winner reaches both requirements on selection

b_test_policy: Never run B_test unless calibration, selection, and confirmation all meet their registered gates.
